exposure: Patients with a history of abdominal surgery (group 1) vs. without (group 2)
outcome: Rate of conversion to open surgery
cohort: 181 patients who underwent surgery for acute appendicitis between March 2021 and March 2022
finding: Laparoscopic appendectomy can be performed safely in patients with previous abdominal surgery, with no significant difference in postoperative outcomes compared to those without prior surgery.
